title: Consumer Contract Audit — Repo Fixture Catalog
description: Per-project catalog of shared mutable fixtures with their consumer maps, kept by each project at .claude/harness/consumer-fixtures.json. Used to pre-fill steps 1 and 2 of the consumer-contract-audit skill when a known fixture is being modified.

catalog_version.description: Semver of the catalog format itself (NOT of the project catalogued).

fixtures.description: Shared mutable fixtures of the project that keeps this file.

name.description: Class.attribute or function/module-level identifier — the exact symbol the audit applies to.

location.description: Source file path relative to repo root.

kind.description: Shape of the fixture — kind names are conventional, not authoritative.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of what the fixture holds and why it exists.

history.description: PR/issue numbers where this fixture was the subject of a consumer-contract regression. Establishes 'this fixture has bitten us before' priors.

consumers.description: Every public-API code path that reads or walks the fixture. Minimum 2 — fixtures with one consumer don't qualify for this catalog.

name.description: Function or method identifier — Class.method or module.function.

location.description: Source file path relative to repo root, optionally with :line.

role.description: Producer = mutates the fixture. Gatekeeper = filters/skips based on fixture state. Accountant = reads contents to produce summary/report.

contract.description: One-line observable contract: '<consumer> depends on <fixture> having <X> when <Y> happens.' Written in terms of what the consumer observes, not implementation detail.

fragility_notes.description: Optional — known coincidences, races, or 'survives only because' caveats. The places future refactors will break.
